title.en: Frank-Egedal pressure and density state assembly
title.zh: Frank-Egedal 压强与密度状态组装

summary: Combine a radial envelope, dimensionless hot-ion moment shapes and supplied gas, density and electron-energy scales into parallel/perpendicular pressures and optional density and electron-temperature fields.

identity.relation: Aligned radial and hot-ion shape fields plus physical scales to anisotropic pressure, density and electron-energy state
identity.direction: (psi, radial_shape, hot_parallel_shape, hot_perpendicular_shape, hot_density_shape, params) -> p_parallel, p_perp, density, electron_temperature
identity.definition: Let r=radial_shape, h_parallel=hot_parallel_shape, h_perp=hot_perpendicular_shape and h_n=hot_density_shape. Select p_hot=hot_pressure_scale or p0 or 1 Pa, and p_gd=gas_dynamic_pressure or 0 Pa. If present, n=r*(gas_dynamic_density or background_density)+r*h_n*hot_density_scale, omitting absent terms; otherwise return density=None, although an internal zero density array is used for electron pressure. If electron_temperature is present, return its constant grid and set p_e=n*electron_temperature; otherwise return electron_temperature=None and p_e=0. Then p_parallel=p_gd*r+p_e+p_hot*r*h_parallel and p_perp=p_gd*r+p_e+p_hot*r*h_perp. Here 'or' in the key descriptions means fallback only when the preferred key is absent, not when it is explicitly None.
identity.model: Pointwise Frank-Egedal pressure-state assembly from externally computed shape fields; it does not calculate the source-mode moments, radial envelope or electron temperature.
identity.geometry: Aligned two-dimensional [Z,R] sample fields; no field or spatial geometry is reconstructed.
identity.coordinates: psi is a finite [Z,R] shape carrier with historical source Wb convention; its values do not enter the formulas. The function does not verify flux units, axis locations or compatibility with other SciRel flux conventions.
identity.boundary: No boundary condition is evaluated. Every shape field must exactly match psi, without NumPy broadcasting or spatial interpolation.
assumptions: The four dimensionless shapes describe the same spatial cells and the same Frank-Egedal closure convention.
hot_pressure_scale/p0 and gas_dynamic_pressure are Pa, density scales are m^-3, and electron_temperature is an energy per particle in J (equivalently Pa*m^3), not an unconverted Kelvin temperature.
Electron pressure is isotropic and is added identically to the two pressure components; no electron anisotropy or quasineutrality is solved.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Finite flux-coordinate field used only for two-dimensional shape and finite-value validation.
inputs.units: Wb by historical source contract; not runtime-enforced
inputs.constraints: Must be finite and two-dimensional; numerical values are not used in the pressure formulas.

inputs.name: radial_shape
inputs.description: Dimensionless radial envelope multiplying all gas, hot-ion and configured density terms.

inputs.name: hot_density_shape
inputs.description: Dimensionless hot-ion density shape, required even if hot_density_scale is absent.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Dict of hot_pressure_scale (fallback p0, default 1), gas_dynamic_pressure (default 0), optional gas_dynamic_density (fallback background_density), hot_density_scale and electron_temperature.
inputs.units: pressure scales: Pa; density scales: m^-3; electron_temperature: J
inputs.constraints: Every selected non-null scale must be finite and nonnegative. A present preferred key overrides its fallback even when its value is None; unrelated keys are ignored.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Gas dynamic, isotropic electron and scaled hot-ion parallel pressures.
outputs.constraints: Finite on successful return; a nonfinite assembled result raises ValueError.

outputs.name: p_perp
outputs.description: Gas dynamic, isotropic electron and scaled hot-ion perpendicular pressures; key is p_perp, not p_perpendicular.
outputs.constraints: Finite on successful return; a nonfinite assembled result raises ValueError.

outputs.name: density
outputs.description: Sum of configured gas dynamic and hot-ion number-density terms, or None if both scales are absent/None.
outputs.constraints: Finite when returned as an array; explicit zero density scales still return a zero array.

outputs.name: electron_temperature
outputs.description: Configured constant electron energy per particle expanded to the psi grid, or None.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative when present; does not convert from K.

preconditions: All five input fields describe the same [Z,R] samples; the four shape arrays are finite, nonnegative and exactly the psi shape.
The caller supplies dimensionally consistent pressure, density and electron-energy scales, not Kelvin values.
supported: Pointwise anisotropic pressure assembly with a common isotropic gas and electron contribution.
Optional gas and hot-ion density scales, optional constant electron energy, and documented legacy scale aliases.
excluded: Computing a radial envelope, hot-ion moments, electron temperature, potential or equilibrium.
Automatic flux-convention conversion, coordinate alignment, spatial interpolation, or proof that supplied scales describe a physically consistent plasma.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-2D/empty/nonfinite psi, mismatched/nonfinite/negative shape fields, non-dict params, or a selected finite-check scale that is negative or nonfinite. Numeric conversion can also raise ValueError or TypeError; preferred keys set to None do not fall back and may fail during float conversion.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any assembled non-null result field is nonfinite after arithmetic. NumPy warnings or allocation/conversion errors can propagate before this final check.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the pointwise assembly performs no iterative solve.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result mapping is returned when validation or assembly fails. A successful result always has four keys; density and electron_temperature can be None.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains a pressure-state assembly associated with a saved historical Pleiades Frank-Egedal operator and migration mapping. Those records are development lineage, not a newly qualified L1 delivery or current SciRel expert recognition; this document describes the maintained callable's observed contract.
source_kinds: saved historical Pleiades operator description and implementation mapping
SciRel direct pressure, density and invalid-input regression tests

python.signature: assemble_frank_egedal_pressure(psi, radial_shape, hot_parallel_shape, hot_perpendicular_shape, hot_density_shape, params)

example.description: Assemble two grid cells with gas, hot-ion and electron contributions and compare both pressure components.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.frank_egedal_pressure_state import assemble_frank_egedal_pressure
psi = np.zeros((1, 2))
radial = np.array([[1.0, 0.5]])
r = assemble_frank_egedal_pressure(psi, radial, np.full((1, 2), 2.0), np.full((1, 2), 3.0), np.full((1, 2), 4.0), {'hot_pressure_scale': 5.0, 'gas_dynamic_pressure': 7.0, 'gas_dynamic_density': 11.0, 'hot_density_scale': 13.0, 'electron_temperature': 17.0})
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['density'], 63.0 * radial)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_parallel'], 1088.0 * radial)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_perp'], 1093.0 * radial)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['electron_temperature'], 17.0)
example.expected: Density is 63 times the radial envelope; parallel and perpendicular pressures are 1088 and 1093 times that envelope in Pa, and electron energy is 17 J at both cells.

scope: A two-by-two case checks independently assembled gas, hot-ion and electron contributions to density and both pressure components.
The no-density-scale case checks density=None, retained electron-energy grid and zero electron pressure.
Nonfinite psi and negative gas pressure are rejected in direct tests; the documented example checks a two-cell assembly.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish selected pressure and density arithmetic plus two invalid-input cases. They do not exhaustively test key-precedence edge cases, all overflow paths, flux conventions, physical electron response, current qualified-source parity, expert recognition or public release.
known_limitations: psi values are validated but not used; the historical Wb label is not a checked connector to other SciRel Wb/rad flux assets.
A configured electron temperature without either density scale returns an electron-energy grid but zero electron pressure and density=None.
The function accepts nonnegative shape fields and scales but does not establish their scientific consistency or source-mode provenance.
Public distribution licensing and current-version expert recognition remain pending.
